The gay-szene entry claims cruising near the basketball area after dark, but the most recent onsite report was 3 May 2017 and found no contacts. Two October 2016 commenters also found nobody, while a November 2015 user made an older positive claim. These long-ago contradictory anecdotes are not current attendance evidence.

Visited evening and observed no one.

records.access_information: Ordinary public park, basketball/play area shared with all visitors; do not imply sexual activity permitted or safe after-dark access.

Gay-szene and Planet Randy preserve its cruising identity, but the latest dated first-person report from 30 May 2025 says a WC encounter occurred about a week earlier and both motorway sides were fenced off from the woodland. Because the encounter precedes 6 November 2025, no in-window activity is established. A May 2023 poster reported the east side empty.

supplementary_sources.note: May 2025 firsthand account says motorway woodland fenced on both sides; old site access, not current verified.

records.description_rewritten: BAT-Park is the former local name for Gustav-Mahler-Park beside Hamburg's central Alster transport corridor. The gay-szene and Planet Randy directories remember it as a longstanding meeting spot, but substantial 2025 clearance/pruning increased visibility. On 19 July 2026, a first-person contributor observed some men standing and chatting but described little activity; October 2025 and April 2025 visits were negative. Thus there is recent on-site interest, not recent proof of sexual encounters or reliable crowds.

supplementary_sources.note: July 19 2026 contributor describes men standing, but no clear encounter.

recent_dated_reports.note: Contributor mentions chatting/standing men, no confirmed encounter.

older_reports.note: Noted regrown shrubs and some men.

records.access_information: Public inner-city park with open sightlines, commuters and families. No official sex permission, night safety or guaranteed seclusion.

records.description_rewritten: Boberger Dünen is a nature reserve and FKK meadow in Hamburg-Bergedorf near Boberger See. Gay-szene and Planet Randy include the destination, and dated 2025 forum users describe cruising or male social presence at its FKK/southeastern meadow; the latest dated comment 2 October 2025 explicitly recalls a July encounter, both before this cycle's cutoff. An independently documented contaminated area on the northern slope near Unterberg has been cordoned off since discovery of dioxin in 2018, with soil replacement underway since late 2025 and expected through 2027. Hamburg authorities confirm Boberger See beach and water did not test contaminated. The exact relationship between this restricted northern slope and historic cruising meadow is unverified.

supplementary_sources.note: Latest Oct 2025 post remembers July 2025 event, both before cutoff.
10 June 2026: north dioxin-impacted reserve section under remediation through end 2027.
Eastern slope cordoned, Unterberg entrance closed; Walter-Hammer-Weg and railroad path as legal passage.
Boberger See beach and lake water were not found contaminated; do not conflate with slope.

older_reports.note: Post recalls encounter in late July 2025, outside freshness cutoff.
Claims activity in tree-covered FKK portion.
Three visits in June, saw some people but wanted more.

records.access_information: Nature reserve; stay on marked legal paths and FKK-designated zones, obey north slope dioxin remediation fences and closed entrance at Unterberg. The Boberger See beach and water are separate from contaminated hillside. Public sex not authorized by FKK designation.
duplicate_and_safety_flags: Northern Boberger Niederung northern slope is fenced off for dioxin cleanup through expected 2027.
Do not incorrectly label Boberger See water/beach contaminated.
Possible different subareas FKK meadow / contaminated northern slope.
